source.check: names read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1911: polled Wednesday 31 May 1911 in six divisions; the other fifteen were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed. W. J. Allen: no party label printed in 1911. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors"); Kernan, 28 May 1914, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests"); nominations in the Portadown News, 2 May 1914, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Armagh County Council")).
